lines.t: Yeah, no autotune, no fake crowns, true talk only
Came from the dirt where the wolves all grin

fake throne stack but the soul stay thin, they flex for the net, I bow to the throne, you chase the bag, I walk alone, never lie with it, never flashy speech, truth move silent, till it gotta preach, steel in the spine, peace in the eyes, don't it cry when the call come down from the sky, I don't move till he say move, I don't speak till he say speak, low walk, head bowed, but the word hit hard when it reach, man of God, no disguise, man of God, no lies,
Yeah, seen kings fold for a moment of fame
Sell to soldiers to light their name
I'd rather wait in the shadows alone
Than rush ahead when he ain't shown
Not my will, not my plan
I don't run unless sent by his hand
Quiet steps, but the ground still shake
When heaven speak, decisions break
Patience louder than a loaded gun
Obedience heavier than what I done
You want power? Learn how to wait
You want truth? Learn how to obey
No religion, no clout chase
Commandments live, not a costumed face
World too loud, spirit too numb, but the call stay clear when the kingdom come
Don't ask why I ain't in the mix, I don't drink poison just to feel legit
Set apart, cut different, chosen, don't blend, they walk submitted
A man of tar and an omnidict word, until called upon to speak
A man of low degree who treads softly, until called upon to act
A lowly man who is, completely in love with me
who does not his own will nor seek his own way a man who waits upon the Lord
and hesitates not when the command comes down from the mouth of the Lord is God a
A man after my own heart, my servant, my friend, says the Lord.
Thanks for watching!
